name: Get Face Report
subcategory: AI face geometry analysis and personal style report
tagline: On-device face scan that scores your facial geometry and builds a private style plan

pricing.basis: free on-device scan; full report is a one-time purchase, no subscription
pricing.notes: Homepage states 'Start my report - $14.79 once' alongside a free on-device scan; JSON-LD on the site also declares a $0 offer for the free scan.

verdictSummary: The measurement core is very buildable in a weekend: a browser face-landmark model plus public anthropometric ratio formulas (facial thirds, width-to-height, symmetry deviation) gets you a geometry score and a basic report. What separates the product is the polish layer - normalized scoring across pose and lighting, plain-language interpretation tuned to be honest rather than flattering, a purchase flow for a full PDF report, and privacy guarantees around photo handling. DIY gets you the numbers; the product packages them credibly.
coreLoopDIY: Load a selfie into an in-browser face-landmark model (MediaPipe FaceMesh or face-api.js), compute symmetry and proportion ratios from the landmarks, score them against reference ranges, and render a plain-language report.
diyTimeEstimate: one sitting for the measurement core; a trustworthy, well-explained report takes longer
requirements: Browser face-landmark model (MediaPipe FaceMesh or face-api.js)
Published anthropometric ratio formulas for symmetry and proportions
No API keys needed for the core on-device flow
whatYouLose: Pose-, lighting- and expression-normalized scoring that keeps results consistent
Interpretation copy tuned to stay descriptive rather than flattering
The polished full PDF report flow and purchase path
Upkeep as browser CV APIs and model quality shift
moatNotes: The measurement math is public anthropometry; the defensible part is a report people trust enough to act on, not the tech.
whyPeopleStillPay: Paying skips the work of picking models, formulas and honest copy: you get a consistent, explained report and a keepsake PDF instead of assembling and validating your own pipeline.

priorArt.name: face-api.js
priorArt.desc: JavaScript face measurement and landmark toolkit

notes: Public submit form was used first; its bot pipeline failed twice ('the pipeline choked on this one'), so this PR follows CONTRIBUTING.md directly. Site facts checked 2026-11-08 against getfacereport.com (free on-device scan, $14.79 one-time full report, no subscription).
prompt: Build me a browser tool that takes a selfie, runs face landmark detection fully on-device, computes facial thirds, width-to-height ratio and symmetry deviation, scores the geometry out of 100, and renders a plain-language report with a personal style checklist - keeping the photo local to the device with no upload step.
